code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen and saturation), severe acidemia (pH 7.0), and mild hypoglycemia. There is leukopenia with neutropenia, lymphopenia, monocytosis, basophilia, eosinophilia, mild thrombocytopenia, and erythrocytosis with increased red cell distribution width. These findings suggest acute severe respiratory failure with possible underlying infection or inflammatory process and bone marrow response. Immediate clinical evaluation is strongly recommended.
